messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage A:
"""
Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant for haematological conditions to be covered. j. Any other treatment using advanced technology, as per the product design. 3) Products are to be made available in compliance with various laws: Insurers shall offer products in accordance with relevant provisions of the following Laws: a) The Mental Healthcare Act, 2017; b) The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016; c) The Surrogacy (Regulation) Act, 2021; d) The Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, and e) The HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017 4) Customer Information Sheet (CIS): CIS is to be provided with every policy in the format as given in Annexure 1. It is a document provided by the Insurer along with the policy document that explains in simple words, basic features of a policy at one place.
"""

Passage B:
"""
6) IRDAI/HLT/MISC/ORD/18/01/2021d ated 29.01.2021 Health Insurance Forum (HIF) – Reconstitution 7) IRDAI/HLT/REG/MISC/199/07/2021 dated 23.7.2021 Extension of the timelines for complying with standards and benchmarks specified due to Covid-19 pandemic. 8) IRDAI/HLT/REG/CIR/108/06/2022 dated 1.6.2022 Use and file procedure for all categories of products under health insurance business 9) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/MISC/150/7/2022 d ated 20.7.2022 Empanelment of network providers 10) 30/IRDAI/HLT/GEN/ministry/2022- 23 dated 12.10.2022 Coverage of internal congenital birth defects 11) IRDAI/HLT/MHCA/CIR/220/10/2022 dated 18.10.2022 Mental illness under the provisions of the MHC Act, 2017 12) IRDAI/HLT/CIR/REG/244/12/2022 dated 8.12.2022 specific waiting period Internal Congenital Anomalies 13) IRDA/HLT/CIR/CSC/097/05/2017 dated 03.05.2017 Products for distribution through Common Service Centres 14) IRDA/HLT/REG/CIR/036/01/2020 dated 28.01.2020 Guidelines on Group Health Insurance Policies upon Merger of Public Sector Banks (PSBs) 15) IRDAI / HLT/ MISC / CIR / 129 / 06 / 2020 dated 02.06.2020 underwriting philosophy - Persons with Disability (PWD) and people affected with HIV/AIDS and Mental Illness 16) IRDAI / HLT/ MISC / CIR / 146 / 06/ 2020 dated 10.06.2020 Guidelines on Public Disclosures by Insurers 17)
"""

Write ONE question whose full answer needs a fact from Passage A AND a fact from Passage B (e.g. combine two rules, or apply one rule to the situation in the other). If no natural question needs both, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts_a": [1-3 word-for-word spans from A], "facts_b": [1-3 word-for-word spans from B], "sub_queries": [a short search query for A's fact, a short search query for B's fact]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If I want a health insurance policy that covers hematopoietic stem cell treatment for a bone marrow transplant, does the insurer need to provide a Customer Information Sheet and also ensure the policy complies with the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017?","answer":"Yes. The insurer must provide a Customer Information Sheet with every policy, and the product must be offered in accordance with the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017.","facts_a":["Customer Information Sheet (CIS): CIS is to be provided with every policy","CIS is to be provided with every policy in the format as given in Annexure 1"],"facts_b":["The Mental Healthcare Act, 2017"],"sub_queries":["\"Customer Information Sheet\" policy","\"Mental Healthcare Act, 2017\" health insurance"]}]}
